gaps.lead: I only found out the truth because I asked.
gaps.sentence: I wouldn't have found out the truth ___ asked.
gaps.explanation: 'Because I asked' → 'if I hadn't asked' — a third conditional.

gaps.lead: At no time did we think that Pedro might be planning to leave the country.
gaps.sentence: It ___ that Pedro might be planning to leave the country.
gaps.hint: it occurred to sb = sb thought
gaps.explanation: 'At no time did we think' becomes 'it never occurred to us'.

gaps.lead: It would be sensible to leave before the traffic builds up.
gaps.sentence: We ___ before the traffic builds up.
gaps.explanation: 'It would be sensible to do' = 'we had better do' — had better + bare infinitive.

gaps.lead: Nadia's friend arrived just as she was about to leave the restaurant.
gaps.sentence: Nadia was ___ the restaurant when her friend arrived.
gaps.hint: be about to = be on the point of + -ing
gaps.explanation: 'About to leave' becomes 'on the point of leaving'.

gaps.lead: You'll fail your exam if you don't revise.
gaps.explanation: unless + present simple = if you don't.

gaps.lead: 'I have never lied to the press,' the minister said.
gaps.explanation: deny + -ing (ever strengthens the denial): denied ever lying.
